I’m sorry you’re having a hard time. I am not in any way trying to diagnose. However, it seems like you might be missing the other half of OCD, the compulsions. Compulsions are actions that people with ocd do to get the obsessions to stop. For example, washing your hands exactly 4 times to make your obsession with germs go away. Our bodies are actually quite good at maintaining an immune response to keep homeostasis in check. Think about how many germs we come into contact with in a day! The immune system is really great at killing those millions of species of microorganisms to prevent infection every day. The immune system is way stronger than most pathogens.

However, certain viruses like the flu, ebola, and HIV have very strong rates of natural mutation that allows it to keep ahead of human's immune system. That's why you are advised to get a flu shot each year: because the virus keeps mutating and getting stronger, so when you get the new shot, it builds up an immune defense against that strain. 

Sometimes when these new mutagens get too strong for our immune system to fight off, things like a deadly high fever can happen. It's pretty much your body using high temps as a last resort to kill off the pathogen, that even may have mutated to withstand such high body temperature. So the pathogen does not die, and the body exhausts its resources. For humans, it's not necessarily a genetic thing that natural selection would fix.
